fato_historico: 1302: Pope Boniface VIII issues the Papal bull Unam sanctam, claiming spiritual supremacy for the papacy.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a powerful moment for personal sovereignty. Just as history once spoke of reaching for supreme spiritual authority, you are invited to reclaim your own inner autonomy. It is a good time to trust your unique vision and honor your truth, letting your authentic self radiate brightly like a four-leaf clover found in a vast, golden field.
frase_do_dia: True power flows when you align perfectly with your own unique inner light.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of shifting perspectives and new beginnings.
conselho: Consider setting a firm intention to honor your personal boundaries with grace today.
